description: Build a company financial profile in one call: the latest value of every supported XBRL concept, grouped by statement. Reads the filer's complete companyfacts payload once rather than one request per concept, so it replaces a run of secedgar_get_financials calls when the question is "what do this company's financials look like right now". Values use the same frame dedup and tag priority as secedgar_get_financials, so the two agree for any concept they both cover. Duration concepts (income statement, cash flow, per-share) report their latest full year and latest single quarter; balance-sheet and entity-info concepts report their latest point-in-time value, since that is the only form they are filed in. A concept the filer does not report is listed under gaps with the XBRL tags that were tried — never zero-filled or interpolated. Use secedgar_get_financials for a full time series of one concept, and secedgar_compare_companies to put several companies side by side.

company.description: Ticker symbol (e.g. "AAPL") or CIK number. Ticker is preferred.

period_type.description: Which duration periods to report per concept: the latest full year, the latest single quarter, or both (default). Balance-sheet and entity-info concepts are point-in-time and always report their latest instant value regardless of this setting.

taxonomy.description: XBRL taxonomy to resolve concepts under. Every concept is looked up in this one taxonomy, so ifrs-full covers only the concepts with confirmed IFRS tag variants and the rest — including the dei entity-info concepts — come back under gaps. Leave at us-gaap for domestic filers, where each concept uses its own preferred taxonomy.

name: secedgar_get_snapshot

caveats.description: Data-completeness warnings. One entry when one or two calendar quarters are absent from every recent qualifying year, because SEC reports a filer's fiscal Q4 as the 10-K residual rather than a discrete quarterly fact — this applies to calendar-year filers (no discrete Q4) as much as to off-calendar ones, and a filer whose other fiscal quarters span non-calendar durations loses a second quarter the same way. One further entry, prefixed with the concept name, per line whose values stop at least two full years behind the newest period this filer reports anywhere in the profile — either because the line resolved to an XBRL tag SEC has retired from the taxonomy, or because a current tag's series simply ends, which is what a migration to a different element or a dropped disclosure looks like. Empty when nothing needs flagging.

concepts_resolved.description: Concepts that produced at least one value.

concepts_total.description: Concepts in the supported catalog that were attempted.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `company_not_found`: The company input does not resolve to a CIK. `ambiguous_company`: The company input resolves to multiple entities and the target is ambiguous. `no_company_facts`: The filer has no XBRL facts at all — pre-XBRL, foreign private issuer, or a non-operating registrant. `rate_limited`: SEC is rate-limiting this server's IP — SEC answered 429, or the call was refused without being sent while the cool-down after one runs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

gaps.description: Concepts with no value for this filer. Deliberately explicit — a missing concept is never zero-filled or interpolated.

items.description: One concept the filer does not report, with the tags that were tried.

concept.description: Friendly concept name that produced no value.

group.description: Statement group the concept belongs to.

tags_tried.description: XBRL tags attempted, in priority order, before giving up.

lines.description: Resolved concepts, ordered by statement group then concept name.

items.description: One resolved concept with its latest value per period kind.

annual.description: Latest full-year (CY####) value. Absent for point-in-time concepts and when period_type excludes it.

accession_number.description: Source filing accession number — pass to secedgar_get_filing.

tag.description: XBRL tag this value was reported under — differs from the line's tag when an older or successor tag in the concept answers this period.

value.description: Reported value, in the line's unit.

group.description: Statement group: income_statement, balance_sheet, cash_flow, per_share, or entity_info.

instant.description: Latest point-in-time (CY####Q#I) value. Present for balance-sheet and entity-info concepts.

accession_number.description: Source filing accession number — pass to secedgar_get_filing.

tag.description: XBRL tag this value was reported under — differs from the line's tag when an older or successor tag in the concept answers this period.

value.description: Reported value, in the line's unit.

quarterly.description: Latest single-quarter (CY####Q#) value. Absent for point-in-time concepts and when period_type excludes it.

accession_number.description: Source filing accession number — pass to secedgar_get_filing.

tag.description: XBRL tag this value was reported under — differs from the line's tag when an older or successor tag in the concept answers this period.

value.description: Reported value, in the line's unit.

tag.description: XBRL tag behind the newest value — each point names its own when the concept walks several.

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy the value was read from.

unit.description: Unit of measure of the newest value (e.g. "USD", "USD/shares", "shares").

period_type.description: Duration periods reported, echoed from input.

taxonomy.description: Taxonomy the concepts were resolved under, echoed from input.
